description: The import's confirm and a stale import preview on Access Roles' dashboard page in the TV layout, as admin, importing nothing: run by accessroles-admin-page-probe.mjs only while the import is offered (no assignment stored), after it created its users pageprobe-kid and pageprobe-teen. The Users tab is remembered from an earlier visit, but the page opens on Overview because the import is offered. The import's preview (a dry run, the users who see every library ticked in), then OK on Apply the import opens the kit's confirm with the focus inside it on Cancel; the D-pad (Right) reaches the confirm button Apply and (Left) goes back; OK on Cancel dismisses it, and so does Back (Escape) the second time, each time with the focus back on Apply the import. Then another administrator changes pageprobe-kid's library access through the stock policy API (one library instead of every one), and OK on the confirm's Apply sends the import with its preview's PreviewToken (ifPreview): 409 Changed naming the kid, the sentence on the page, Apply off until a new preview and the focus on Preview the import. The kid's access is put back; nothing was imported.

steps.name: the TV layout, and the Users tab remembered from an earlier visit
the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true; })()

steps.name: the check's helpers
the import is offered, so the page opens on Overview, not the remembered Users tab
the users who see every library ticked in (the preview has someone to import)
steps.script: const box = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportEveryLibrary'); if (!box.checked) box.click(); return box.checked;

steps.name: the focus on Apply the import (the D-pad put it there)
the kit's confirm, the focus inside it on Cancel
the D-pad reached the confirm button
the focus back on Apply the import, the opener, and Apply enabled
OK again (on Apply, where the focus came back)
the focus back on Apply the import after Back too
another administrator changes pageprobe-kid's library access after the preview (one library instead of every one, through the stock policy API), so the import would propose another role for them
steps.script: const users = await ApiClient.getUsers(); const kid = users.find(u => u.Name === 'pageprobe-kid'); const libraries = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Libraries')); const one = libraries.find(l => l.Enabled && l.CollectionType !== 'boxsets'); window.__arPageKid = { id: kid.Id, policy: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(kid.Policy)) }; await ApiClient.updateUserPolicy(kid.Id, Object.assign({}, kid.Policy, { EnableAllFolders: false, EnabledFolders: [one.Id] })); const now = await ApiClient.getUser(kid.Id); return { before: kid.Policy.EnableAllFolders, all: now.Policy.EnableAllFolders, folders: now.Policy.EnabledFolders.length };

steps.name: the kid sees one library now (they saw every one)
OK on Apply the import a third time
the confirm, the focus on Cancel
Right on the D-pad to the confirm button
OK on Apply (the confirm button): the import is sent with its preview's PreviewToken
refused (409 Changed: what the import does isn't what its preview showed, for the kid): the confirm closed, the sentence shown, Apply off until a new preview, the focus on Preview the import
the kid's library access put back as it was
steps.script: await ApiClient.updateUserPolicy(window.__arPageKid.id, window.__arPageKid.policy); const now = await ApiClient.getUser(window.__arPageKid.id); return { all: now.Policy.EnableAllFolders, folders: now.Policy.EnabledFolders.length };

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
